capture_method: OneROM live substitution; checksum-protected RBCP; verified restoration

observation_profile.phases: NOP bit0 (+2 CCK), EXG bit1 (+3 CCK); conditional branch costs also apply; recorded brackets are authoritative
observation_profile.event_offset: CIA Timer-A latch32+offset E clocks; Copper WAIT line66 h60+2*offset CCK
observation_profile.watchdog: Copper SOFT level1 at line70 h60; all ordinary handlers disable all sources
observation_profile.units: raw VHPOSR words, register flags, absolute stacked PC; no alignment or packed-beam subtraction
observation_profile.launch: pre/post source release VHPOSR; exact bracket cohorts only
observation_profile.limitations: Input marker is not a pin timestamp. Qualify on pre-enable input only; never align output traces. Requires independent hardware repeats.
observation_profile.variants: low2 controls; bit2 CPU writer; bit3 RAM observer

fields.38: common-ROM pre-COPEN/COPJMP input beam; all later beams are measurements

repeatability.note: Zero conflicts does not establish cross-run repeatability when phase cohorts do not overlap.

uncontrolled_state: PAL A500 stock 68000, 512KiB chip/512KiB slow; silicon revisions unconfirmed. CLXDAT is a digital pixel witness, not an electrical pointer bus measurement. Exact write/read beam brackets are retained; no alignment. New input precedes enable/restart; output brackets are measured, not eligibility filters.
